hero.eyebrow: A sandwich shop on Laurens Street
hero.title: Mouth-watering subs, *made the South Jersey way*
hero.lede: Hot subs on Amoroso rolls, Boar’s Head meats and cheeses, house-marinated roast beef and sirloin, salads and vegetarian options, with daily soup and sandwich specials. Call it in and pick it up at the curb.

sections.title: The *menu*
sections.intro: Make any sandwich a combo with a side and a fountain drink, tea or bottled water for $3.50.

items.name: The Boardwalk Special
items.desc: House-marinated sirloin with grilled peppers, mushrooms and caramelized onions, American and Boar’s Head provolone on an Amoroso roll, the South Jersey way. Also with chicken. Double the meat as “The Maxwell” for $3 more

items.name: The Joe Meatball
items.desc: Beef and sausage meatballs, grated Parmesan, tangy marinara and Boar’s Head provolone on an Amoroso roll

items.name: The Dirty Bird
items.desc: Grilled chicken breast, peppers, caramelized onions, Boar’s Head provolone and a teriyaki glaze on an Amoroso roll

items.name: The Yardbird
items.desc: House-breaded fried chicken tenders with Boar’s Head ham and melted pepper jack on an Amoroso roll

items.name: The Pulled Hammy
items.desc: Boar’s Head ham piled high with Swiss, pickle chips and whole-grain mustard on an Amoroso roll, panini style

items.name: The Dubliner
items.desc: Boar’s Head pastrami and turkey with Swiss, MacK’s coleslaw and bacon jam on grilled marbled sourdough and rye

items.name: The Palmetto
items.desc: House-marinated roast beef, Boar’s Head bacon, Swiss and red-wine-glazed mushrooms on grilled sourdough, with au jus

items.name: The Hitchcock
items.desc: A MacK’s original: house roast beef, Boar’s Head turkey, Vermont cheddar, coleslaw, lettuce, tomato and bacon jam on toasted berry wheat

items.name: The Ludlow
items.desc: Boar’s Head pastrami and melted Swiss on grilled marbled sourdough and rye

items.name: The Pacer
items.desc: Boar’s Head pastrami-seasoned turkey, sauerkraut and Swiss on grilled marbled sourdough and rye

items.name: The Funky Chicken
items.desc: Blackened chicken, caramelized onions, Boar’s Head bacon and pepper jack on grilled marbled sourdough and rye

items.name: The Southern Diva
items.desc: Shaved house-marinated roast beef, MacK’s coleslaw and Boar’s Head Swiss on sourdough

items.name: The MacK Attack
items.desc: Grilled cheese on Parmesan-crusted sourdough with all the cheeses and Boar’s Head bacon

items.name: The Triple Bogey (BLT)
items.desc: Five slices of Boar’s Head bacon, tomato and lettuce on toasted berry wheat

items.name: The Whaley
items.desc: House-made tuna on marbled sourdough and rye, with lettuce and tomato

items.name: The Plantetarian
items.desc: A black bean patty with all the veggies in a flour tortilla wrap, with your choice of dressing

items.name: The Chicken Toes
items.desc: House-breaded chicken tenders with MacK’s sauce or buttermilk ranch

items.name: Salads

sections.title: From Angelo’s Subs *to Laurens Street*

image.alt: A sub loaded with grilled steak, mushrooms and melted cheese

body: David Kangas was 15 and working at Angelo’s Subs in Northfield, New Jersey, when he decided he wanted his own sandwich shop. Kitchen jobs through college, at Garrett’s in Five Points, the Capital City Club and Windemere, kept the dream growing; a corporate career put it on the back burner.
Years later, the dream finally came to life on Laurens Street.
